criteria.text: `configPatch`/`scopePatch.agentConfigId` is resolved/validated server-side from the signal's profile — the LLM names the profile, the generator resolves the id via `AgentConfigsRepository`. An LLM-emitted row id is never trusted directly.
criteria.test_id: issue-01-c3: an LLM-emitted agentConfigId is never trusted directly — it is resolved/validated server-side against the affected profile
criteria.reason: Confirmed failing pre-implementation: no resolution step exists yet — configPatch (and any agentConfigId on it) is never persisted at all.

criteria.text: A diagnosis that omits or malforms the structured patch still creates the proposal (prose-only) — it is not dropped here. It gets refused at approve time by Issue 2's validator with an actionable reason.
criteria.test_id: issue-01-c4: a malformed configPatch (invalid field name) is dropped but the proposal is still created prose-only
criteria.reason: Passes today by construction — current code has no patch handling at all, so malformed patches can't break proposal creation. Kept as a real-code-path regression guard for after implementation lands (must still hold once configPatch parsing exists).

criteria.text: Unit tests: parse round-trip of both patch shapes; malformed patch degrades to prose-only; `agentConfigId` resolution from profile name via `AgentConfigsRepository`.

criteria.reason: Backward-compatibility half of c5 passes today by construction (no patch fields exist yet to break). The round-trip half is covered by c1/c2, which fail as required.
